notablePrerequisites:
3 counters on Chronozoa or other permanents.
3 mana value or less creature in graveyard or top of library.
description:
Activate Tayam for {3} and removing 3 counters from Chronozoa.
Sacrifice Chronozoa to its Vanish trigger.
Create two token copies of Chronozoa due to its death trigger.
Return a 3 mana value or less creature to the battlefield.
Sacrifice a Chronozoa token and the other creature to ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
